name: tea-terraces-b 40 x 40 m assembly sample
axes: Blender: x right, y back (+Y uphill), z up. Unity with bakeAxisConversion: (x, z, y); rotation_z_deg becomes a rotation about Unity -Y; mirror_x is scale x = -1
ground_note: y -20 .. -18 at z 0 is a flat strip that is not part of the kit (placeholder plane)
row_rule: row k: front edge y = -18 + 4k, piece origin z = k, soil z = k + 1
not_included: TE01_InnerBend / TE01_OuterBend (joined to straights in the Unity check); no official placement in the game scene
